WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_id,
        p.bats,
        AVG(bp.double) AS average_doubles
    FROM batting_postseason AS bp
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id
    WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL
      AND p.bats <> ''
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats
),
player_indices AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        average_doubles,
        average_doubles / AVG(average_doubles) OVER () AS index
    FROM player_averages
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        bats,
        average_doubles,
        index,
        index - AVG(index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS difference
    FROM player_indices
)
SELECT player_id, bats, average_doubles, index, difference
FROM scored
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A player's records are grouped by player_id and batting hand, and AVG ignores NULL doubles values; players with records but no non-NULL doubles remain with a NULL average and index.
